description: Geopolitical events over a look-back window (days_back 1..90, default 7) — conflict, chokepoints, sanctions and related signals. The public cut. Pass layers to narrow — waterways, armed_conflicts, hotspots, regulatory, cyber, sanctions — comma-separated. All six together run large and two of them truncate; one or two layers come back much deeper. row_limits on the response says what was in force, so a layer that ended can be told from one that was cut off. Two reference layers are opt-in and not in the default set: disasters (USGS, GDACS, EONET) and displacement (UNHCR, by origin and corridor).
name: get_world_events
title: Get world events
